notes: Polite です/ます form for every sentence (messages, help text, dialogs); the user is addressed implicitly (no あなた), with honorific ご/お only in fixed courtesy phrases (お試しください, ご確認ください). Buttons and menu items are short nouns or noun+verb phrases without a final 。 (保存, 名前を変更, 表紙をダウンロード); headings and labels have no final punctuation, while full sentences end with 。. English "X — try again" error/toast messages become two sentences: 〜できませんでした。もう一度お試しください。 Use full-width punctuation (、。：！？（）) and 「」 for quoted UI names, option names and printer settings; …/〜 for ellipsis/ranges. No spaces between Japanese and Latin words, numbers or placeholders (PDFをダウンロード, {n}冊). Product names and Lulu's English-only option names stay in English (wrapped in 「」 inside sentences). Sign in/out = ログイン/ログアウト; the book's contents (interior) = 本文; printing professionally = 印刷会社で印刷.

terms.short edge / long edge: 短辺とじ / 長辺とじ
